episodes:
<cognition:processor_input>
  <host_input>
    <processing:input>
      <input stimulus:event="bot.input" stimulus:source="gabe">
        <content>
          <entry key="text" value="again" />
        </content>
      </input>
    </processing:input>
  </host_input>
  <prior_episodes count="5">
    <cognition:cognitive_episode focus="lamp" stimulus_name="bot.input">
      <focus_candidates count="2">
        <item>lamp</item>
        <item>fan</item>
      </focus_candidates>
      <output count="2">
        <cognition:event target="session.communication" event="bot.ability.communication.respond" reason="greet">
          <data>
            <entry key="text" value="hi" />
          </data>
        </cognition:event>
        <cognition:event event="bot.focus_device" />
      </output>
      <behavior>
        <behavior:create event="bot.behavior.create" name="ping" description="answer pong" reason="asked" source="<scxml/>">
          <triggers count="1">
            <item>ping</item>
          </triggers>
        </behavior:create>
      </behavior>
    </cognition:cognitive_episode>
    <cognition:cognitive_episode stimulus_name="bot.input">
      <focus_candidates count="0" />
      <output count="0" />
      <behavior>
        <behavior:break event="bot.behavior.break" name="ping" reason="stop" />
      </behavior>
    </cognition:cognitive_episode>
    <cognition:cognitive_episode stimulus_name="x">
      <focus_candidates count="0" />
      <output count="0" />
      <behavior>
        <behavior:create name="noevent" />
      </behavior>
    </cognition:cognitive_episode>
    <cognition:cognitive_episode>
      <focus_candidates count="0" />
      <output count="2">
        <cognition:event />
        <cognition:event />
      </output>
      <behavior>
        <behavior:change event="bot.behavior.change" name="n" description="d">
          <triggers count="0" />
        </behavior:change>
      </behavior>
    </cognition:cognitive_episode>
    <cognition:cognitive_episode>
      <focus_candidates count="0" />
      <output count="0" />
    </cognition:cognitive_episode>
  </prior_episodes>
  <standing_directives count="1">
    <cognition:directive text="Remember green." kind="instruction" />
  </standing_directives>
</cognition:processor_input>
environment:
<cognition:processor_input>
  <host_input>
    <processing:input>
      <input stimulus:event="bot.input" stimulus:source="lamp">
        <content>
          <entry key="target_device" value="lamp" />
        </content>
      </input>
    </processing:input>
  </host_input>
  <prior_episodes count="0" />
  <standing_directives count="0" />
  <environment id="room">
    <self state="processing">
      <_-dash>e</_-dash>
      <_.dot>d</_.dot>
      <_9lives>cat</_9lives>
      <a_b>space</a_b>
      <awake>true</awake>
      <big>1e+21</big>
      <count>3</count>
      <level>1.5</level>
      <mood>calm</mood>
      <pos>
        <x>0</x>
        <y>2.25</y>
        <z>
          <w>deep</w>
        </z>
      </pos>
      <tags count="2">
        <item>a</item>
        <item>b</item>
      </tags>
      <tiny>1e-7</tiny>
      <_moji__>u</_moji__>
      <owned_devices>
        <device ref="fan" id="session.fan" state="off" />
        <device ref="lamp" id="session.lamp" state="on">
          <brightness>80</brightness>
          <color>warm</color>
          <on>true</on>
        </device>
      </owned_devices>
    </self>
  </environment>
</cognition:processor_input>
